address: 2F, 2-6 On Ning Road, Yuen Long, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: This bright, fresh and long-standing Cantonese restaurant serves dim sum and ‘Walled Village’ cuisine, alongside assorted Cantonese classics. Walled village-style five-flavour chicken boasts flavoursome, velvety meat. Other specialities include roast duck with bean paste and coriander; claypot rice with lard, premium soy sauce, steamed mullet with salted lemon; and, above all, the steamed sponge cake. Also check out the seasonal menu....
